blind.description: A pair of small wooden buckets or churns placed side-by-side. Each is constructed from vertical wooden staves bound with dark metal bands. One bucket is covered with a flat wooden lid featuring a raised central handle; the other bucket is open and filled to the brim with white milk, spanned by an arched handle with a twisted rope grip. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: Two touching circular rims aligned vertically in view; the top bucket contains white liquid spanned diagonally by a rope handle, while the bottom bucket shows a wooden lid with an angled handle bar.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 1.8 to 2 feet tall) and roughly 1.5 feet wide across both buckets.
